title.value: Estimating the lagged effect of price discounting: a time-series study using transaction data of sugar sweetened beverages
title.justification: This is the title as provided in the paper, summarizing the study's focus on analyzing the effects of price discounting over time.
title.quote: Title: Estimating the lagged effect of price discounting: a time-series study using transaction data of sugar sweetened beverages.

extractions.description: The paper investigates the lagged effects of price discounting on the sales of sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) using transaction data from a large supermarket in Montreal, Canada, from 2008 to 2013. The study employs a time-series analysis to analyze the immediate and delayed sales increases on five categories of SSBs due to price discounting, highlighting any sustained increase in sales post-discounting. Of interest is that sports and energy drinks showed a sustained sales increase post-discounting, suggesting a possible underestimation of the effects of promotions on these items by prior studies.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is primarily focused on analyzing consumer purchasing behavior in response to retail pricing strategies and does not directly address climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This study used secondary data that are aggregated store-level measurements of consumer purchasing, rather than individual consumer level data. The study therefore did not require a separate written or verbal consent from human subjects.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not align with any specific climate or ecological sustainable development category as it deals with consumer behavior related to price discounting of beverages.
primary_category.quote: Background: Price discount is an unregulated obesogenic environmental risk factor for the purchasing of unhealthy food, including Sugar Sweetened Beverages (SSB).

secondary_categories.justification: There are no secondary climate or ecological sustainable development categories applicable as the paper focuses on marketing and consumer behavior impacts rather than ecological or climate issues.
secondary_categories.quote: The findings and analytical method in this study promote improved validity of future food environment research targeting the impact of discounting and other types of food promotions on the sales of energy-dense and nutrition-poor food items.

primary_sub_category.justification: No sub-category fits because the focus is not on any specific area listed under the sustainable development sub-categories.
primary_sub_category.quote: Price discounting, the temporary reduction of price per unit food, is one of the most important marketing tactics used by food retailers and manufacturers to increase sales.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The study does not directly address any of the predefined sub-categories under climate or ecological sustainable development, as it is rooted in consumer price sensitivity and sales analysis.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The objective of this study is to conduct a time-series analysis to assess the presence and magnitude of a lagged effect of discounting for five SSB categories based on weekly time-series of retail transaction data in a large supermarket in Montreal, Canada.

applications.value: Research on consumer price sensitivity and sales impact
applications.justification: This application is central to the paper which focuses on understanding the effects of price discounting on consumer purchases of sugary beverages.
applications.quote: Previous research focusing on the immediate effect (i.e., same time period) of price discounting may have systematically underestimated the impact of price discounting for some food categories.

new_primary_category.justification: No new category is suggested as the study doesn't focus on climate or ecological themes.
new_primary_category.quote: The findings and analytical method in this study promote improved validity of future food environment research targeting the impact of discounting and other types of food promotions on the sales of energy-dense and nutrition-poor food items.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category is suggested as the paper's primary focus is not on sustainable development themes.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Even after a period of price discounting has ended, the sales of sports and energy drinks remain at a higher level relative to the sales before discounting.
